jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Why Socure ? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Automation team. You will play a critical role in designing and building scalable data platforms and pipelines that power Socure’s identity verification products and analytics. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong passion for solving real business problems with data, and combines deep hands-on data engineering expertise with strong ownership. jobs.title: Apprentice BI Data Analyst
jobs.description: Opportunity   Brunswick Group is seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Apprentice BI Data Analyst to join its Group Business Intelligence (BI) team. The Group BI team plays a key role in supporting the business globally by delivering meaningful data, reporting and analysis to inform strategic decisions. Working closely with Finance, FP&A, the Commercial Hub and other business teams, the function develops and maintains reporting systems and BI dashboards, helping stakeholders better understand financial performance, revenue and recovery data. The successful candidate will work within the BI development team, reporting to the BI Technical Support Analyst. The role involves providing technical support, investigating and resolving reporting issues, and assisting with the development and improvement of dashboards to enhance self-service reporting across the firm. Alongside gaining hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure SQL Server and Power BI, the successful candidate will complete a Level 4 Data Analyst Apprenticeship. We are looking for a motivated individual with strong analytical and interpersonal skills, a keen interest in data and technology, and a willingness to learn. Previous Business Intelligence experience is not required, as training and mentoring will be provided. Applicants must meet the apprenticeship eligibility requirements. About the Role  Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Perform daily integrity checks Investigating issues raised by end-users and resolve them or escalating them to the development team Provide immediate solutions to system issues and liaise with other support teams to ensure prompt resolution Manage small scale changes through to completion Perform quality assurance tests and assisting with new release processes Automate and enhance workflows Manage and administer reporting security Collaborate with people across the firm to enable them to self-serve Business Intelligence through Power BI Work

jobs.title: Data Engineer – Healthcare
jobs.description: About PAICON PAICON is a Heidelberg-based health data intelligence company building the global health data foundation through its PaiX ecosystem, working to close the representation gap in medical data so personalised medicine works for everyone. We harmonise ethically approved, GDPR compliant real-world health data from providers around the world into a global dataset. The data covers multiple modalities on various disease entities. Our flagship product, PaiX Navigator, generates actionable insights for pharma, biotech and AI companies worldwide. The role We are looking for a hands-on data engineer to integrate data from our global partners into our platform. Data integration is the core of the role, and agentic AI tooling is part of how we do it. This is an on-site position in our Heidelberg office. You will work closely with medical, engineering and commercialization colleagues in a small, pragmatic team with short decision paths and direct access to the founders. What you'll do Onboard new data partners, from first assessment of their data through to reliable production ingestion Map partner data to our internal data model and work with providers to close gaps Build and maintain robust, well-tested data pipelines Ensure high standards in data quality and help evolve our database and data infrastructure Document data and transformations so that every step is transparent and traceable Ensure data is handled securely, de-identified and in line with healthcare data regulations Help us apply AI-assisted methods to data integration, with appropriate quality checks What you bring Several years of hands-on data engineering, including building and running production data pipelines Strong SQL and relational database design skills R and Python skills on Linux systems Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7 FHIR and common clinical coding systems Understanding of data privacy and security in a regulated environment, including GDPR Day-to-day use of AI-assiste

jobs.title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
jobs.description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future. Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform. We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems. We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role. Responsibilities Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation. Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance. Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers. Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation. Requirements Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch. Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them. Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet. You will build the foundation that fixes this. What you'll do Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent. Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io . Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today. Treat the warehouse like a product.
